item.title: Cloud in a Bottle: making self-hosting accessible to everyone
item.description:
📝 I think a big reason is the shift of software into the cloud. Nowadays, cloud software is centralized, with one instance of the software serving the world, and the costs borne by the creator. This is because individuals don't have an accessible way to put software into the cloud for themselves.
🔗 Read more: https://cloudinabottle.org/blog/launch-post

item.title: Chrome again exempts Google from user site data settings
item.description:
📝 The blog post was about a Google Chrome bug that mysteriously exempted Google-owned sites from the setting to automatically delete all site data. This data persists even if I quit and relaunch Chrome. com is the only site exempted by Chrome.
🔗 Read more: https://lapcatsoftware.com/articles/2026/9/1.html
